name: user
description: Manages a DuploCloud AI user account, including identity, roles, and metadata.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Username or handle for the user.

attributes.name: email
attributes.description: Email address of the user (required by the backend).

attributes.name: display_name
attributes.description: Human-readable display name shown in the UI.

attributes.name: external_subject
attributes.description: Subject identifier from the external OAuth/SSO provider.

attributes.name: roles
attributes.description: List of roles assigned to the user.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Whether the user account is active. Defaults to true when omitted.

attributes.name: last_login_at_utc
attributes.description: Timestamp of the user's last login (RFC 3339, UTC).

attributes.name: created_at
attributes.description: Timestamp when the user was created (RFC 3339).

attributes.name: updated_at
attributes.description: Timestamp when the user was last updated (RFC 3339).

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version counter, incremented on each update.
